decisions.reason: Because this illuminated candle arch extends the firm's core handcrafted seasonal décor and was featured prominently with several models, it fits existing know-how and can be improved through normal workshop learning.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to the firm's established competence base and homepage promotion suggests enough early promise to retain it in the range.

Although the electronic music box is technologically more distant from the firm's traditional craft capabilities, its flagship status and multiple models justify giving it more time to learn and adapt commercially.

As a distant accessory tied to the uncertain electronic music box platform and only lightly presented on the website, it is more likely to be cut if management concentrates resources on products it understands better.
This Christmas motif platform depends on the same distant electronic system while adding only a narrow seasonal variant, making it a likely candidate for withdrawal under limited absorptive capacity.
The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's traditional product architecture and craftsmanship, so management is likely to keep it and refine it within the existing assortment.
